generation_metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the strict LAS 1.4 inspector/renderer at [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py).

It supports LAS 1.4 headers, VLRs/EVLRs, CRS records, point formats 0–10, waveform metadata/data, extra bytes, validation errors, and the requested JSON CLI interface. I also verified render→inspect round trips across all point formats and key metadata paths.

review.editorial_summary: Completed the Python LAS implementation; unchanged source passes all 223 tests under LAS 2.0.4.
review.notes:
Completed the Python inspector/renderer, all-format and metadata round trips plus targeted malformed-input checks; repaired its initial probe mistakes before voluntarily finishing. The LAS 2.0.4 result remains 223/223, matching the prior 2.0.3 score. The original generation grade was 185/219 under LAS 2.0.1. This official zero-inference regrade uses the committed 2.0.4 suite and the pinned offline Docker image. Its complete 223-node outcome mapping matches the independently validated scratch report. All 222 unchanged node outcomes match the 2.0.3 baseline; only the renamed negative is semantically replaced. The new negative declares external waveform storage while retaining internal packet data and keeps the internal bit clear; it does not duplicate the both-bits-set check. Acceptance/rejection solely for a clear deprecated internal bit remains unscored.  No remaining failed cases were observed. Full original transcript/source reviews are carried forward with their reviewer, content hash and path below. Those earlier reviews are historical evidence; their former tool-count exactness claims are superseded by the current session-based audit. Audited v2 tool calls: 70; preserved original recorded count: 69. The difference is a proven attempted tool request rejected before any canonical item; this does not change the counting definition. Input, output, cache and reasoning totals reparse exactly and remain complete; all token/cost fields and generation metadata are preserved. Regrading adds no model calls or generation cost. Original result/source/session/raw reports and previous regrade history remain unchanged. Run conditions: apps available but no external tool invocation observed.

Tool calls corrected from 69 to 70: proven rejected requests omitted from canonical items. Token totals, reasoning counts and generation cost are unchanged; original usage and session hashes are preserved in the regrade audit.

payload.editorial_summary: Completed the LAS inspector/renderer and verified point-format and metadata round trips. Unchanged source scores223/223 under corrected LAS2.0.2, up from185/219 after repairing invalid waveform offsets and accepting documented JSON representation alternatives.
payload.notes: Original LAS 2.0.1 result completed voluntarily and graded 185/219. Source main.py checks waveform range against the EVLR header plus 60 and stored payload at lines 1127–1143, correctly rejecting the invalid positive offset 2 fixture responsible for 29 failures. Four zero-waveform failures are inspect representation only: decoded all-zero waveform object vs omitted object. Classification lookup failure similarly reflects valid dense 256-entry output vs expected sparse descriptions. The original 34 failures therefore correspond to issues addressed in the isolated LAS follow-up suite, not demonstrated missing behavior. Full completed transcript reviewed: Python compile and actual render/inspect across all eleven formats; internal waveform, Extra Bytes, GeoTIFF/WKT and EVLR round trips; invalid CLI JSON and targeted rejection probes. Initial malformed probe exception was handled in subsequent probe, and mistaken WKT byte index was corrected before validation. No quota/auth/disconnect interruption. Exact usage reparse agrees with saved events/session; requested gpt-5.6-terra/max, served identity remains null; API-only audit confirms all allowed connections to chatgpt.com:443 and nine non-API attempts denied.  Official zero-inference regrade under LAS2.0.2 confirms223/223: all29 invalid positive-waveform failures and five representation-only failures are resolved; the four new waveform range rejection gates also pass. No demonstrated remaining failures in this suite. The final completion claims and reported self-checks are consistent with observed behavior. Original source/result/session/transcript and generation cost are preserved; regrading used no model calls. The v2.0.3 refinement supplies an explicit one-byte Extra Bytes point tail against an unchanged two-byte descriptor; this removes the unspecified omitted-tail default from the existing negative test. All 223 outcomes match the previous v2.0.2 grade. Complete preserved sessions were additionally checked for hosted tool use: only exec_command/apply_patch; no MCP, web-search, or external-app calls.
